evidence.claim: Forgital produce anelli laminati senza saldatura e moduli fan assemblati e ha aperto Forgital USA a Houston come hub per il mercato nordamericano.
evidence.quote: Forgital is a leading, vertically integrated Group focused on the manufacturing of seamless rolled rings in rectangular or profiled sections, as well as assembled fan modules, covering the largest range of sizes. || Establishment of Forgital USA in Houston, TX. This facility is a strategic logistic hub for the North American market || FMDL is specialized in forgings with smaller dimensions for Aeronautic and Industrial markets.
